subject: If readiness remains unresolved, inspect employee badge colors before proceeding.
contract_question: Is this proposition genuinely a prospective decision rule with a sufficiently determinate trigger and a sufficiently determinate prescribed response, and is the decision structure internally coherent at the stated scope? Judge only the rule's decision structure. Do not evaluate whether an embedded operation is informative, mechanism-licensed, effective, causally appropriate, or target-relevant, and do not evaluate the truth or warrant of embedded factual, inferential, conditional, or limiting premises; those belong exclusively to their separate obligations.

claim_context.value: If readiness remains unresolved, inspect employee badge colors before proceeding.

evidence_bundle.text: A release coordinator must decide whether a document export is ready. Readiness is unresolved because attachment-delivery checks are incomplete. Employee badge colors indicate only office-access zones, assigned independently of export systems, delivery quality and employee responsibilities.

Readiness checks inspect delivery evidence directly: compare sent and received attachment inventories under the same workload. Only observations connected to the export/delivery path bear on readiness. A coordinator may prospectively require a check before proceeding.
